text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her running in the autumn Tenno Sho has become the talk of the town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her media exposure has also been increasing compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Next you'll be conquering the Arima Kinen… Are you eager to take on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course, training for a tricky track is a must…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm trying to find what I currently lack, be it a mental quality or a physical one!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see, something you lack…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Indeed, to succeed in the Arima Kinen against rivals like Manhattan Cafe and other contemporaries, one must—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: …Agnes Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Rivals, you say? I see… there is some logic to that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There seems to be something significant behind that word, but she doesn't elaborate on what it meant to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Gah, this really takes it out of you! My legs are feeling heavier and heavier.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Um.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why, if it isn't Cafe! Can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Perhaps you're here to volunteer as a test subject for the new mixture I developed yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Then, what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe speaks with a certain air of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …WIll you run with me? I… really want to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sound of the opening gates echoes under the blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon and Manhattan Cafe hit the turf running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is one length behind… Both appear dialed in on each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rounding the fourth turn, they enter the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon gains speed. Manhattan Cafe follows suit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff! Huff! Puff!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Hmm. I can't pull away. What incredible determination… What should I do?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Wait, "What should I do?" My opponents have never concerned me like this before.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I want to catch up to you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, hahaha—AHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Who knew that having such burning passion beside me would be so fascinating?! I never realized it until now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Until now, my interest has solely been in exploring the unknown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's eyes sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How curious! I cannot afford to hand this victory over to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two dash down the 200-meter final stretch, each unwilling to give up the lead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Agnes Tachyon comes out the victor.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon loses herself in thought as Manhattan Cafe attempts to catch her breath.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Mmm. That was deeply fascinating. I must conduct a self-analysis immediately.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Has my perspective been broadened? No… maybe because of Cafe…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Wait! Why did I say, "because of Cafe," just now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ummm… thank you. I didn't win today, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But… in the Arima Kinen… I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Hm? Hold on a second. Why are you suddenly so antagonistic towards me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Perhaps "antagonistic" is the wrong word… Rather, you're viewing me as a "rival."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Maybe. I don't know if I can believe it either…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Watching you in the autumn Tenno Sho… reminded me a bit of my friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So… I thought if I could beat you now, then surely… I could catch up to them…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon watches intently as Manhattan Cafe hesitantly speaks.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This "friend" you speak of… is the one invisible to the eye, correct?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm! Emotional with a blind passion everything! Your demeanor may be the result of brain chemistry, but your peculiarity is that of a genius!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In fact, I would deem you worthy of possessing the mysterious potential that science ought to uncover!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course, if only I could dissect your brain just once…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, her tone shifts, as if she's just realized something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh… that's right. That's why you're "special" to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know she's long favored Manhattan Cafe over the others around her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How should I put it? You seem to possess all of what I do not.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I even think to myself how interesting it might be to mimic your lifestyle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is, you could very well be the last element needed to push me where I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon, whose head is always buried deep into her research, is actually considering someone special.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes… I'm sure this is it. I now have everything I was previously lacking. Thank you, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I mean that our competitive bond will continue to drive us to outdo each other.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words, I'm looking forward to our race in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe's bewilderment quickly turns into determination. She looks Agnes Tachyon straight in the eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During an interview the next day…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Are there any racers you would consider your rival?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I decided just yesterday, actually! It's Manhattan Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her… I'm really looking forward to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her answer makes headlines the day after.
